articles.title: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
articles.content: The Indian rupee closed almost flat after peaking at a seven-month high during early trading on Wednesday. Robust foreign investments in local stocks provided a boost, but a stronger dollar capped further gains. The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

articles.title: SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
articles.content: SpiceJet's board of directors announced a fundraising plan to raise up to Rs 5,500 crore. The airline's shares have surged significantly, hitting the upper circuit for six consecutive sessions. Flight cancellations and operational disruptions have caused significant challenges for SpiceJet in recent days. The airline is focusing on rebuilding capacity and ensuring operational reliability going forward. The fundraising aims to strengthen its financial position and support fleet expansion efforts.

articles.title: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report
articles.content: The government is reviewing proposals to cut securities transaction tax on cash equities by 50% while raising levies on derivatives to curb speculative trading and encourage broader market participation. Officials are also considering a reduction in long-term capital gains tax. The recommendations will be presented to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman ahead of Budget 2027.

articles.title: India bonds rise tracking easing crude oil, US Treasury yields
articles.content: The Indian bond market is experiencing a positive shift, with bond yields decreasing as oil prices and Treasury yields fall. The 2036 benchmark bond yield is now at 7.2393%, reflecting a minor drop. Additionally, crude oil prices have plummeted more than 20% since their October peaks, providing a temporary buffer against inflation.
